## Type of branch
- [ ] `feature/*` or `bugfix/*` → `develop`
- [ ] `release/*` → `main` (and back-merge to `develop`)
- [ ] `hotfix/*` → `main` (and back-merge to `develop`)

## Checklist
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`make test`)
- [ ] `make lint` is clean
- [ ] CHANGELOG notes added (release/hotfix PRs: via `scripts/bump_version.py`)
- [ ] Linked issue: #
